paragraphs: Rav Yosef bar Chavush Maya, in Rabbi Abbahu’s time. Yoma 27a and the final chapter, 87a: Rav Yosef bar Chavu raised a contradiction to Rabbi Abbahu. Certainly Yuchasin’s ‘Chavush Maya’ is an error [ע״ס as printed; formula reading provisional]. There, 87a, Rav Yosef bar Chavu says: one brings ten people to his grave and asks his forgiveness.
